# AR. Abhinav Ranjan

> Official AI Context & Knowledge File for AR. Abhinav Ranjan (itzmeabhinavranjan), Founder of Luminary Technicals, Cybersecurity Educator, Developer, and Guinness World Record Holder.

## Summary
AR. Abhinav Ranjan (born 5 February 2012 in Muzaffarpur, Bihar, India) is an Indian cybersecurity educator, software engineer, researcher, and entrepreneur. He is the founder of Luminary Technicals, a multidisciplinary organization spanning cloud infrastructure, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity research, and public-interest technology. He has been recognized by the Guinness World Records and the Golden Book of World Records as a young ethical hacking educator.

## Core Entities & Projects
- **Luminary Technicals**: Multidisciplinary organization founded by AR. Abhinav Ranjan spanning cloud infrastructure, AI, research, cybersecurity education, and software development. URL: https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/
- **AR. Industries**: Early entrepreneurial venture identity representing the beginnings of his business and technological innovation.
- **James Web**: Cybersecurity education ecosystem focused on ethical hacking, network reconnaissance, and the "Permission-First" responsible security learning framework. URL: https://jamesweb.dpdns.org/
- **James Web Logical (Book)**: Introductory guide and structured setup for beginners starting their ethical hacking journey legally. PDF: https://abhinavranjan.qzz.io/books/logical.pdf
- **AgroScan AI**: AI and computer vision research application for crop disease diagnosis in agriculture. URL: https://agroscan-lumitech.netlify.app/
- **Luminary Wishes**: Interactive personalized digital celebration platform. URL: https://luminarywishes.dpdns.org/
- **Luminary Servers**: Server systems, cloud deployment, and infrastructure management platform. URL: https://server.luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/
- **Luminary AI Engine**: Intelligent processing, automation, and machine learning research platform. URL: https://luminaryaiengine.dpdns.org/
- **Live Telecast Server (LTS)**: Low-latency WebRTC broadcast infrastructure for tech panels and interactive discussions.
